biggest_catch: You must be a brand-new member with no Redstone account in the past five years, living in a restricted list of Alabama/Tennessee counties and ZIP codes — and the $475 doesn't arrive until up to 150 days after you open.
catches: New members only: no Redstone FCU account of any kind in the previous five years.
Restricted geography: eligible Alabama and Tennessee counties and ZIP codes only, and you must remain a resident of the eligible area.
Primary savings and checking must be opened on the same day with a valid promo code; keep the $5 share savings and fund the $25 checking opening deposit.
Within 60 days: log into online banking at least once and make five point-of-sale debit purchases — ATM withdrawals are excluded.
Consumer accounts only; age 13+; bonus limited to twice per household and once per member.
Employees and their families are excluded; checking account fees vary by account type.
Accounts must remain open and in good standing through payout.

c1.evidence: Redstone Federal Credit Union is a real Alabama/Tennessee credit union; the terms are published in an official RFCU PDF on prodr.redfcu.org.

c2.evidence: Official 2026 Summer New Member promo PDF states the $475 bonus, the June 2–October 3, 2026 window, the five-year new-member rule, the same-day account-opening requirement, and the online-banking and debit-purchase conditions.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to participate; the $5 share savings and $25 checking opening deposit are disclosed account-opening deposits.

c4.evidence: Official PDF states the bonus is paid within 150 days of account opening, no later than March 2, 2027.

eligibility: New members only (no RFCU account in the previous five years); age 13+; consumer accounts; must live in the listed eligible Alabama/Tennessee counties and ZIP codes and remain a resident; accounts open and in good standing; limit twice per household, once per member; employees and families excluded.
notes: Official Redstone FCU 2026 Summer New Member promo terms PDF reviewed 2026-09-23. Offer runs June 2–October 3, 2026.
payout_quote: $475 bonus for new members who open a primary savings account and a checking account on the same day between June 2 and October 3, 2026, with a valid promo code, and who log into online banking once and make five point-of-sale debit purchases within 60 days.

steps: Confirm you have had no Redstone FCU account in the previous five years and that you live in one of the eligible Alabama or Tennessee counties or ZIP codes listed in the promo terms.
Between June 2 and October 3, 2026, open a primary share savings account and a checking account on the same day using a valid promo code.
Keep the $5 share savings balance and fund the $25 checking opening deposit.
Within 60 days of opening: log into online banking at least once and make five point-of-sale debit-card purchases. ATM withdrawals do not count.
Keep both accounts open and in good standing, and remain a resident of the eligible area.
Receive the $475 bonus within 150 days of account opening, no later than March 2, 2027.
timing: Bonus paid within 150 days of account opening, no later than March 2, 2027.
